I should reply to the tenant confirming this, notify the landlord, and follow up accordingly.

I'll send a message to the tenant confirming the earliest end date, send the landlord a request asking whether they'd accept an earlier date like 10 November, and schedule a follow-up around late November to arrange checkout and key return — without inventing specifics like an address since none was given. Rent stays due until the actual end date unless the landlord waives it.

arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and good luck with the new job. We've received your notice today (10 October 2026).

Since the Renters' Rights Act came in on 1 May, tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. The earliest your tenancy can end is 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable up to that date.

If you'd like to leave on 10 November, that only works if your landlord agrees in writing. We're asking him now and will tell you his answer. Please don't assume an earlier date until you hear from us.

We're starting your move-out now:
- Keys: please hand them back to us (not to the landlord or a neighbour) on or before your final day. We'll confirm exactly where and when once the end date is settled.
- Check-out: we'll contact you to arrange a check-out inspection around your final day, with at least 24 hours' notice.
- Deposit: your £2,019 deposit is held in the mydeposits scheme. After check-out we agree any deductions with you. If we can't agree, the scheme's free dispute service decides. Undisputed money is returned within 10 days of agreement.

We'll be in touch again by 17 October with the landlord's answer.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings

arguments.decision_needed: Tom Achterberg (Flat 2, 5 Navarino Road) gave notice today wanting to leave 10 Nov. Do you agree in writing to that earlier end date?
options: Decline: tenancy ends on the valid date, 10 December 2026 (recommended unless you have a new tenant lined up)
Agree in writing to an end date of 10 November 2026 (rent then stops from that date)
arguments.update: Valid notice is two months, so the earliest end date is 10 Dec 2026. We have started move-out against that date without waiting: check-out inspection and key return to be arranged, and the tenant told how the deposit (mydeposits, £2,019) is returned after check-out. Please reply by 17 Oct 2026.

arguments.purpose: Arrange check-out inspection and key return with Tom Achterberg for end of tenancy 10 Dec 2026 (or earlier date if landlord agreed in writing); give 24h notice.
Chase landlord for answer on earlier end date (10 Nov) and update tenant.

Given today is 10 October 2026 and notice was served today via email, the two months' written notice under the periodic tenancy rules means the earliest the tenancy can end is 10 December 2026, unless the landlord agrees in writing to an earlier date. I should reply to the tenant confirming this, notify the landlord, and follow up accordingly.

I'll send a message to the tenant confirming the earliest end date, send the landlord a request asking whether they'd accept an earlier date like 10 November, and schedule a follow-up around late November to arrange checkout and key return — without inventing specifics like an address since none was given. arguments.body:
Hi Tom,

Thanks for letting us know, and good luck with the new job. We've received your notice today (10 October 2026).

Since the Renters' Rights Act came in on 1 May, tenants need to give two months' written notice, so one month isn't enough. The earliest your tenancy can end is 10 December 2026. Rent stays payable up to that date.

If you'd like to leave on 10 November, that only works if your landlord agrees in writing. We're asking him now and will tell you his answer. Please don't assume an earlier date until you hear from us.

We're starting your move-out now:
- Keys: please hand them back to us (not to the landlord or a neighbour) on or before your final day. We'll confirm exactly where and when once the end date is settled.
- Check-out: we'll contact you to arrange a check-out inspection around your final day, with at least 24 hours' notice.
- Deposit: your £2,019 deposit is held in the mydeposits scheme. After check-out we agree any deductions with you. If we can't agree, the scheme's free dispute service decides. Undisputed money is returned within 10 days of agreement.

We'll be in touch again by 17 October with the landlord's answer.

Kind regards,
Mare & Co Lettings

options: Decline: tenancy ends on the valid date, 10 December 2026 (recommended unless you have a new tenant lined up)
Agree in writing to an end date of 10 November 2026 (rent then stops from that date)

We have started move-out against that date without waiting: check-out inspection and key return to be arranged, and the tenant told how the deposit (mydeposits, £2,019) is returned after check-out. Please reply by 17 Oct 2026.

Chase landlord for answer on earlier end date (10 Nov) and update tenant.
